etymologies.etymologyHTML: Back-formation from assets, from Anglo-Norman asetz, from Old French assez (“enough”). Compare Middle English asseth.

definitions.definition: (accounting) Any item recorded on the left-hand side of a balance sheet.
A thing or quality that has value, especially one that generates cash flows.

quote.citation: January 31 2020, Boris Johnson, Brexit Day speech
quote.text: And when I look at this country’s incredible assets. Our scientists, our engineers, our world-leading universities, our armed forces. When I look at the potential of this country waiting to be unleashed, I know that we can turn this opportunity into a stunning success.

definitions.definition: (software) Any component, model, process or framework of value that can be leveraged or reused.
(slang, usually in the plural) A woman's breasts or buttocks or a man's genitalia.
